info.title: CT-VL admin RESTFul API Documentation
info.description:
This RESTful API exposes all the functionalities available in the GUI.
The swagger `YAML` document can be found [here](/vts/admin/v1/doc/swagger.yaml).

Authorization

You can retrieve a JWT by calling [/api/api-token-auth/](/api/api-token-auth/) with your username/password. Then insert the JWT contained in the authorization header. > **Example:** Bearer gf43d[...]ey7hw

alphabet.title: Alphabet
alphabet.description: A sequence of characters or a range (in HEX digits) defining the character set

predefined.title: Predefined value
predefined.description: True if it's a predefined character set. False if it's a custom character set

range.title: Character set is a range
range.description: Character set type. True if it's a range, False if it's a sequence of alphanumeric characters

seedkey.title: Seedkey
seedkey.description: Key that is used to generate the random tables. Only one key can have seedkey set to True.

session_key.title: Session key
session_key.description: JWT used by the authenticated user

showleft.title: Showleft
showleft.description: Number of unencrypted characters starting from the left

showright.title: Showright
showright.description: Number of unencrypted characters starting from the right.

key.title: Key
key.description: Symmetric key this permission applies to

asymkey.title: Asymkey
asymkey.description: Asymmetric key this permission applies to

opaqueobj.title: Opaqueobj
opaqueobj.description: Opaque Object this permission applies to

keepleft.title: Keepleft
keepleft.description: Number of character to leave unencrypted starting from the left

keepright.title: Keepright
keepright.description: Number of character to leave unencrypted starting from the right

irreversible.title: Irreversible
irreversible.description: Set irreversible to true if you never want the token to be detokenized

copyruntdata.title: Copyruntdata
copyruntdata.description: Return uncencrypted data instead of an error if teh input is smaller than 2 characters

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: An optional prefix to be added to all tokens

startyear.title: Startyear
startyear.description: The smallest year the input data is assumed to fall

endyear.title: Endyear
endyear.description: The highest year the input data is assumed to fall

username.title: Username
username.description: Required. 150 characters or fewer. Letters, digits and @/./+/-/_ only.

is_active.title: Active
is_active.description: Designates whether this user should be treated as active. Unselect this instead of deleting accounts.

is_staff.title: Staff status
is_staff.description: Designates whether the user can log into this admin site.

is_superuser.title: Superuser status
is_superuser.description: Designates that this user has all permissions without explicitly assigning them.

ldap_user.title: Ldap user
ldap_user.description: Boolean value determining if it's an AD user

admin_password.title: Admin password
admin_password.description: Password of the currently authenticated user (must be a superuser)
